method: Enumerate effective runtime command registries across all discovered contexts and node types. Capture handler identity and source candidates. Source scanning inventories GUI controls/import dependencies/tests. Mode/context arrays consolidate shared inherited registrations; no/default forms remain explicitly unverified. Does not equate registry presence, test-name matches, or parser acceptance with behavior or Cisco fidelity.

scope.unit: One node + canonical registered path + handler hash; modes and context entries are consolidated. Windows variants use a separate explicit syntax unit. Arguments and no/default forms require separate evidence.
